content: A friend is a person with whom I may be sincere. Before him I may think aloud.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: True friendship is a sanctuary of radical honesty. In the presence of a genuine friend, all social masks, defenses, and pretenses dissolve into mutual trust.
practicalInsight: Reach out to a close friend and share your genuine, unfiltered thoughts without feeling the need to impress.
reflectionPrompt: With whom in your life can you drop all pretenses and think aloud with complete sincerity?
